resources.string: Select an Uberhar Precompiled data folder
Create an empty folder named Uberhar Precompiled for this comparison app. Keep your main Uberhar and Azahar data folders separate.
Use a separate folder for Uberhar Precompiled
Create an empty folder, or select a folder already initialized by Uberhar Precompiled. Your main Uberhar and Azahar data folders must stay separate. Copy any saves you want to test after setup.
